chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl, who said:
I saw him praying in his sandals; he did not remove them, and I think he said: “the two rakʿahs of tawaf.”
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer), including the two rakʿahs of tawaf, while wearing sandals?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Imam عليه السلام was seen performing salat (prayer) while wearing his sandals without removing them. It appears specifically to refer to the two rakʿahs of tawaf, indicating the permissibility of praying in sandals in that context.
